stories.title: Pope Leo to have surgery after lump found on lung
stories.summary: The Vatican says Pope Leo will undergo surgery after a routine check found a lump on his lung, a procedure that will briefly sideline the pontiff.

stories.title: Yemen fighting expands as Houthis attack Saudi airport: What to know
stories.summary: A suspected Houthi missile attack on Riyadh killed 12 people and injured around 300, prompting Saudi Arabia to shut the airport and widening the conflict in Yemen.

stories.title: Delhi protests continue after ’cockroach’ group leaders freed
stories.summary: More demonstrations have hit Delhi after authorities released the leaders of a group officials have called ’cockroaches’, extending a bout of unrest in the city.

stories.title: Trump says ’time for Ukraine to get new president’ after Zelensky condemns diesel deal
stories.summary: Donald Trump suggested Ukraine should get a new president after Volodymyr Zelensky condemned a diesel deal, the latest sign of strain in relations between the two.

stories.title: Testing a local AI agent built on an open Hermes–Qwen model on a Mac Studio
stories.summary: The Verge documents ongoing hands-on testing of a local AI agent powered by an open Hermes–Qwen model running on a Mac Studio, exploring what on-device AI can do.

stories.title: Cheaper AI tokens are driving more demand — Jensen Huang’s best-case scenario
stories.summary: Nvidia chief Jensen Huang argues falling AI token prices are driving more usage rather than shrinking the market, a key bet behind his growth outlook for AI chips.

stories.title: ArXiv caps submissions at two per month as AI paper flood overwhelms the preprint server
stories.summary: The arXiv preprint server is limiting researchers to two submissions a month as the surge of AI papers strains the archive, underscoring how fast machine-learning output has grown.

stories.title: Microsoft’s Nadella bows to Trump language rules on ’Super Intelligence’ and hits back at OpenAI and Anthropic
stories.summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella said he will follow Trump-administration language guidelines on the term ’Super Intelligence’ while using the dispute to criticize OpenAI and Anthropic.

stories.title: Browns face ’trap game’ test against struggling Jets
stories.summary: Sunday’s road preview notes Cleveland enters as a favorite against a winless Jets team but warns it carries classic trap-game risk ahead of a stiffer schedule.

stories.title: Would the Browns trade for Khalil Mack?
stories.summary: Columnist Mary Kay Cabot weighs whether Cleveland should pursue Chargers edge rusher Khalil Mack in a trade to strengthen its pass rush.

stories.title: Beating Jets a test for Browns’ credibility: Terry Pluto’s prediction
stories.summary: Columnist Terry Pluto says a win over the Jets would prove Cleveland is a genuine contender and gives his prediction for the Week 5 road matchup.

stories.title: Buckeyes looking for revenge as Indiana week begins
stories.summary: Ohio State turns to Indiana week seeking payback for last year’s loss, with defensive end Eddrick Houston saying the team wants back what it felt it had earned.

stories.title: College GameDay picks Notre Dame–BYU over Ohio State–Indiana rematch
stories.summary: ESPN’s College GameDay chose Notre Dame vs BYU as its next show site instead of the Big Ten title-game rematch between Ohio State and Indiana.

stories.title: Locksley: Ohio State ’really deserving’ of its ranking after 45-16 loss
stories.summary: Maryland coach Mike Locksley credited the No. 5 Buckeyes after the 45-16 defeat, saying Ohio State is deserving of its ranking.

stories.title: Proof points from Ohio State’s blowout win over Maryland
stories.summary: Eleven Warriors breaks down the numbers and highlights behind Ohio State’s 45-16 homecoming victory over Maryland.

stories.title: Gasly questions stewards for not penalising Norris after Singapore crash
stories.summary: Pierre Gasly questioned why race stewards chose not to penalise Lando Norris after their Singapore GP collision, arguing a penalty was warranted.

stories.title: Hadjar ’pissed off’ after mechanical problems at Singapore GP
stories.summary: Isack Hadjar aired his frustration after mechanical trouble again derailed his Singapore Grand Prix weekend.

stories.title: FIA admits fairness was compromised in Singapore sprint qualifying ’mess’
stories.summary: The FIA acknowledged that fairness was undermined during a chaotic Singapore GP sprint qualifying session and pledged to review how it ran the session.

stories.title: Despite dropped charges, Whitehall recall effort continues
stories.summary: Organizers in Whitehall are pressing ahead with a recall campaign even after charges in the matter were dropped, NBC4 reports.

stories.title: Police: 1 critically injured in Newark bar shooting
stories.summary: One person is in critical condition after a shooting at a Newark bar, and police are investigating what led to the overnight incident.

stories.title: Lynd Fruit Farm buys 74 acres in Licking County
stories.summary: Lynd Fruit Farm, a long-running Licking County destination, is expanding after agreeing to buy 74 additional acres.

stories.title: Multi-vehicle crash closes south Columbus road
stories.summary: A multi-vehicle crash shut down a south Columbus road, prompting a police investigation and delays.
